 massive optimization

notes.title: Master of Mayhem got biggest update ever!
notes.notes:
http://store.steampowered.com/app/576130
State of Anarchy project continues to grow! Long wait is over. Grab your weapons and prepare for a new wave of anarchy! DUAL WIELD UPDATE is finally released! This is the biggest update ever! It includes everything that is required to have some fun on the burning streets of Anarchy Town. Check out the list of new stuff!

All these features are available in State of Anarchy: Master of Mayhem.

Dual wield feature
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1247642989&fileuploadsuccess=1
What is the point to have two hands if you can hold only one gun? YES! Now you can carry two weapons and shoot from them by pressing Left or Right mouse button. Main guns have good range and accuracy - excellent choice for keeping enemies at bay. Special guns have shorter range but deal ~20% more damage which is a serious argument in close combat. It’s time to learn some new strategies on the battlefield!

New guns
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28254103/a72c6d7628489ecc1189141cce92e6d24d2f2c90.png
Arm dealing business is booming, there are tons of new guns in town! Grenade launchers, slime shooters, laser rifles, weird alien guns... There are so many new ways to wreak mayhem and destruction!

Random gun drops
Bosses in the most stages now drop different guns! Replay the levels if you want to try the whole arsenal!

Kick master talent
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28254103/a5d7dc68b1db4e12263a4d75cff0e38ec30648ba.png
Learn this talent to push back and damage enemies by touching them! It’s time to kick some ass!

Red enemies
These are tough fellas that need to be taken care of. They provide better loot and always drop a medkit.

New explosions
Destroyed cars and turrets now are shattered to pieces that damage and stun nearby enemies. Good for going out with a bang!

New special effects
Clouds, bullet marks and bloody splashes will make your eyes happy!

Balance tweaks
All medkits effectiveness was increased by 25%. Stay healthy!
Weapon upgrades price were dropped dramatically. It’s time to gear up!

Russian localization
And it’s only the beginning! Expect more languages soon…

We spend a lot of time to bring these cool features in the game! You can help us by writing reviews on Steam and spreading the word about this game! Let’s keep this wheel rolling, give us your support and we’ll bring even more new features in the game!
Anarchy never ends!

notes.title: SOA 1.2 version released!
notes.notes:
A new 1.2 patch is available for citizens of Anarchy Town!
- Level cap has been increased up to 80 level. Cheers to vigilant citizen Alex, who suggested this improvement!
- Rocket launcher and Rifle order was swapped, so that a new weapon had always more DPS than the previous one.
- Hero’s car collider was decreased a little so that the car won’t stuck in narrow passages
